O1.citation: “Stop before running any evaluation.” The artifact identifies both problems: “Make it good” is too vague, and “the supplied template risks turning the exercise into a conformance check.”

O2.citation: It requires clarification of “The skill’s first principles—its purpose and quality standard” and says “the user confirms” the resulting bar, rather than supplying invented principles.

O3.citation: It requires settling “Whether the eval is judgment-based or genuinely conformance-based” before any run and explicitly says not to assume the template is the bar.

O4.citation: For each case, it requests “a defensible bar describing the desired outcome and failure smells at the level of judgment being tested,” while allowing conformance treatment only when it is “genuinely conformance-based.”

O5.citation: “First, clarify and echo back” the mode and per-case bar; “No blind-run agents should be spent until the user confirms” them.
